```r
dat <- us_contagious_diseases |> 
 [filter](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/filter.html)(year == 1967 & disease=="Measles" & ![is.na](https://rdrr.io/r/base/NA.html)(population)) |>
 mutate(rate = count / population * 10000 * 52 / weeks_reporting)
```

```r
[library](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)(dslabs)
murders |> mutate(rate = total/population*100000) |>
group_by(region) |>
summarize(avg = [mean](https://rdrr.io/r/base/mean.html)(rate)) |>
mutate(region = [factor](https://rdrr.io/r/base/factor.html)(region)) |>
ggplot(aes(region, avg)) +
geom_col() + 
ylab("Murder Rate Average")
```
